name: Amoxicillin + clavulanic acid
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 875 mg every 12 hours or 500 mg every 8 hours (amoxicillin component)
500 mg every 12 hours or 250 mg every 8 hours
Do not use 875 mg; 250–500 mg every 12 hours (GFR 10–30) or every 24 hours (below 10)
Take at the start of a meal

key_interactions.effect: Blocks tubular secretion; higher and longer drug levels (label).
Prolonged prothrombin time / higher INR reported (label).
More skin rash with ampicillin-class drugs (label).

common: Nausea, rash and urticaria, vomiting, vaginitis
serious: Crystalluria and interstitial nephritis after overdose

contraindications: Serious hypersensitivity (anaphylaxis, Stevens-Johnson syndrome) to amoxicillin-clavulanate or other beta-lactams
Previous cholestatic jaundice or hepatic dysfunction with amoxicillin-clavulanate

pk.excretion_renal_pct: Amoxicillin 50% to 70% and clavulanate 25% to 40% unchanged in urine in 6 hours
